decision: 2026-09-26: the symbolic environment does not simulate the sensor (proposal 6.2). Detection = GT position within range + 2D line of sight against walls and doors, the grid sensor model of multi-object search (Wandzel et al., ICRA 2019; pomdp_py). habitat_render is kept only as a reference for validation.

wall_los_2d.source: range: D435i recommended range 0.3-3 m (proposal 2.(1)); 360-degree disk because the robot observes 6 headings 60 deg apart at each goal (step < D435i RGB HFOV 69.4 deg, so the headings cover the full circle); band excludes walls of other storeys; occluders are opaque structures in the scanned state used by the NavMesh (glass: window, shower door, sliding door, glass excluded); contact tolerance: standard ray-casting epsilon so objects flush with a wall stay visible

visibility.source: max_range: D435i recommended range; min pixels: COCO small-object boundary 32x32 px
